# J122_FREEV_D_G10: exact low-arithmetic own154 nonwinner

NEW rational homogeneous convex3-polyhedron, true V67/E195/F130,C390, own strict(S,U,H)=(1,5,4), additionalweak000 and primitivezero000. Exactly four positive P, no Q. Not own110, not an improvement of canonical own110 C622. Its importance is a freely changed V geometry with one actual stable facet, only67 extreme points and modest rational arithmetic, not its equilibria count.

Derived by finite actual-mass whole-P path motion from the separate J122_QPATH_H_G8 own121 seed, through an H-family with76 vertices, then a free V-family. Complete producing source/checkpoints are in J122 methods parts1–4. This exact recovery does NOT require rerunning the optimizer. The float D was rejected by a half-predicted-gain rule then admitted under a separately stated ACTUAL common-gain predicate; the predicate change is preserved, not silently attributed to the old producer. Freezing uses grid10^10 and exact projection of six specified material points onto the rounded original stable plane. The own centroid is recalculated; no reference-centre substitution is used. Here the actual sole stable maximal triangle is audited independently of that old plane label.

## Complete reconstruction unit: rebuildv122.py
1214B,SHA7f5b09f132efbda283cfadb0183a8e867b42e34b197a963d07209fd556a9cb17. Enumerates EVERY point triple and checks every point by integer arithmetic; no float hull incidence is trusted. Every maximal supporting facet of a full-dimensional3D point hull has a noncollinear triple. The H audit additionally proves boundedness and returns only67 vertices, all checked to belong to the literal76-point set.
```python
"""Exact supporting-plane reconstruction of the J122 integer V capsule."""
import itertools,math,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('J122_FREEV_D_G10.vertices.txt');a=list(map(int,p.read_text().split()));m,den=a[:2];assert len(a)==2+3*m
X=[a[2+3*i:5+3*i] for i in range(m)]
def dot(x,y):return sum(a*b for a,b in zip(x,y))
def sub(x,y):return [a-b for a,b in zip(x,y)]
def cross(a,b):return [a[1]*b[2]-a[2]*b[1],a[2]*b[0]-a[0]*b[2],a[0]*b[1]-a[1]*b[0]]
P=set()
for i,j,k in itertools.combinations(range(m),3):
 n=cross(sub(X[j],X[i]),sub(X[k],X[i]));h=dot(n,X[i]);side=0
 if not any(n):continue
 for x in X:
  r=dot(n,x)-h
  if not r:continue
  t=1 if r>0 else -1
  if side and side!=t:side=2;break
  side=t
 if side==2 or side==0:continue
 if side==1:n=[-a for a in n];h=-h
 n=[a*den for a in n];gg=math.gcd(*n,h);row=tuple(a//gg for a in n+[h]);assert row[3]>0;P.add(row)
s=str(len(P))+' 0\n'+''.join(' '.join(map(str,p))+'\n' for p in sorted(P))
assert len(P)==130 and len(s.encode())==15902
assert hashlib.sha256(s.encode()).hexdigest()=='0be9687fa3cf6b570e41b847bf7026241fbe8723969ccd2a07390149b5a1b8d0'
Path('J122_FREEV_D_G10.txt').write_text(s)
print('J122_FREEV_FULL_EXACT_SUPPORTS_REBUILT',m,len(P))
```
